description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
When Mishra's Bauble enters, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Resolve the Builder's Talent trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
